name: VM Migration (vMotion)
summary: Move a VM to another cluster of the same datacenter, optionally to another datastore.
description: Live-migrates the VM (vMotion / cross-cluster, optionally with Storage vMotion) to the connected host of the target cluster with the lowest memory usage. Pre-checks: EVC compatibility, port groups available on the target hosts, datastore free-space floor of the site and memory headroom of the target cluster. Runs as soon as it is approved; a scheduled migration window is planned for a later version.

inputs.name: TargetDatastore
inputs.label: Target datastore
inputs.help: Leave empty to keep the current datastore (it must be shared with the target cluster).

inputs.name: KeepPortGroups
inputs.label: Keep port groups (check every target host)
inputs.help: The VM keeps its networks. On: every connected target host must have them (DRS can move the VM later). Off: only the destination host is checked.
